basis: CAWG Delegated Creator Taskforce 20 and 23 November 2026

controls.disposition: Report signature integrity only; authority indeterminate; no verified authority claim

controls.condition: Missing, invalid, expired or revoked sponsorship evidence
controls.disposition: Do not display a verified sponsorship label from this experiment. Distinguish lack of proof from affirmative denial and disclosure obligations.

controls.condition: Delegation accepted, consent missing or withdrawn
controls.disposition: Evaluate consent separately; no inferred permission. Preserve claimed historical and current states.
No automatic fetch and no proof from pointer alone; authorization and verification of fetched bytes remain separate.

controls.condition: Unknown, substituted, stale or future source
controls.disposition: No authenticated matching claim; preserve reason and non-positive assurance.
No inferred legal relationship or authority; external policy and evidence required.
Independently assess each grant and consent; missing acceptance and renewal must not propagate.

controls.condition: Trusted current observation, historical use time supplied by caller
controls.disposition: Do not infer historical authority or trusted signing time; retention and authoritative historical status external.

controls.condition: Public result with identity or agreement details
controls.disposition: Closed output contract; no raw subject, key, reference or terms in public report.

controls.condition: Actual signed asset or C2PA tool receipt
controls.disposition: Keep content integrity, signer trust, delegation binding and consent separate; independent asset/trust gate remains open.
